افتضخت (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَخْتُ (iftaḍaḵtu) /if.ta.dˤax.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اِفْتَضَخْتَ (iftaḍaḵta) /if.ta.dˤax.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اِفْتَضَخْتِ (iftaḍaḵti) /if.ta.dˤax.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اِفْتَضَخَتْ (iftaḍaḵat) /if.ta.dˤa.xat/: third-p
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
